# M0-4a: Install headless claude on hoid + offline flag check + U11/U12 research

- Milestone: M0
- Branch / worktree: `t/M0-4a`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M0-4a`
- Depends on: none
- Touches (exclusive while running): `spikes/claude/`, `docs/build/spikes/claude.md`; on hoid: `~/.local/bin`, `~/.local/share/claude`,
  `~/.claude` only
- Plan refs: architecture.md §5a; requirements.md U11, U12
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (this is a one-off install on hoid, approved by Brendan 2026-10-28)

## Goal
The native `claude` CLI is installed on hoid for user `brendan` without sudo. Every §5a flag is confirmed to exist in that
version's `--help`. U11 (usage headroom) and U12 (subscription terms for personal automated use) are researched with
sources. Runtime checks that need auth wait for M0-4b, after Brendan runs `claude setup-token` (BA-6).

## Setup facts (verified by sup)
- `ssh hoid` works non-interactively from this Mac (BatchMode): Linux x86_64, user `brendan`, bash, 417G free.
- hoid has no `claude`, no node, and no `~/.local/bin` yet.

## Scope
- Install the **native** claude build with Anthropic's official native installer (docs.claude.com / code.claude.com setup
  page; read it first and use the documented command). Target `~/.local/bin/claude`. If the installer offers a
  version/channel choice, use stable. Record the exact version installed. finbot will pin it (§5a).
- Make `~/.local/bin` reachable for non-login, non-interactive ssh (`ssh hoid claude --version` must work). If that needs a
  `~/.bashrc`/`~/.profile` PATH line, keep it to one clearly commented line, and say what you changed.
- Confirm that each §5a flag exists in `claude --help`, using `claude --help` and any `claude <subcmd> --help` (no auth needed).
  Make a table of flag → present/absent → exact help text, for:
  - `-p`
  - `--output-format json`
  - `--tools`
  - `--strict-mcp-config`
  - `--mcp-config`
  - `--allowedTools`
  - `--json-schema`
  - `--permission-prompts`
  - `--setting-sources`
  - `--disable-slash-commands`
  - `--append-system-prompt-file`
  - `--resume`
  - `--system-prompt-snapshot`
  - `--bare`
  - `setup-token`

  Note any renamed or replacement flags.
- Research U11 and U12 from official Anthropic sources (pricing/plans pages, usage-limit help articles, Consumer Terms,
  Claude Code docs on `setup-token`/headless use). Quote the relevant lines with URLs. Label conclusions VERIFIED (a source
  says so explicitly) or UNVERIFIED (inferred).
- Write `docs/build/spikes/claude.md`:
  - the install steps as they actually happened (the reproducible recipe for the Dockerfile in M1/M3);
  - the version;
  - the flag table;
  - U11/U12 findings;
  - a list of what M0-4b must verify at runtime: `--resume` picking up a new `--mcp-config`, the `--json-schema` output
    shape, `--permission-prompts none` behaviour and latency;
  - a recommendation;
  - an "Impact on architecture" section.

## Out of scope
- **Running anything that needs auth**: `claude -p`, `setup-token` (that's Brendan's), `/login`. Don't set any tokens.
- sudo, apt, system config, Docker, nginx, or anything outside the hoid paths listed above. Installing node/npm.
- Changes to the root module, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/plan/*`.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] `ssh hoid claude --version` prints the installed version (show it).
- [ ] The flag table is complete in `docs/build/spikes/claude.md`, with presence quoted from `--help`.
- [ ] U11/U12 have quoted sources with URLs and labels.
- [ ] The M0-4b runtime checklist is in the doc.
- [ ] `ssh hoid 'ls -la ~ | head; cat ~/.bashrc | tail -5'` shows only the expected changes (state them).
- [ ] Root `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` still green.
